name: SLOWSHED-floor
old: if (slowWaits.length < SLOW_SHED_MIN || waited / trips < SLOW_SHED_WAIT_MS) return;   // a quick request keeps nothing open
new: if (slowWaits.length < SLOW_SHED_MIN - 1 || waited / trips < SLOW_SHED_WAIT_MS) return;   // a quick request keeps nothing open
note: one request fewer than the floor opens the shed

name: SLOWSHED-threshold-side
note: a database exactly at the threshold not shed

name: SLOWSHED-span
note: slow requests long gone keep the shed opening

name: SLOWSHED-unweighted
old: for (const w of slowWaits) { all += w.ms; asked += w.trips; }
new: for (const w of slowWaits) { all += w.ms / w.trips; asked += 1; }
note: the mean a request's, not a trip's - a request of a hundred slow trips weighs as one

name: SLOWSHED-quick-keeps-open
old: if (slowWaits.length < SLOW_SHED_MIN || waited / trips < SLOW_SHED_WAIT_MS) return;   // a quick request keeps nothing open
new: if (slowWaits.length < SLOW_SHED_MIN) return;   // a quick request keeps nothing open
note: a quick request keeps the shed open past the drain

name: SLOWSHED-nothing-counted
note: a shed read (no trip) counted as a quick request

name: SLOWSHED-uncapped
note: AUDIT LEAN-READS C4: one heavy statement in a quiet isolate opens the shed

name: SLOWSHED-unsaid
old: if (nowMs >= busyShedUntil) console.warn(`[busy] slow: the shed opened
new: if (false) console.warn(`[busy] slow: the shed opened
note: AUDIT LEAN-READS C6: the shed opens with no word in the log

name: SLOWSHED-said-each
old: if (nowMs >= busyShedUntil) console.warn(`[busy] slow: the shed opened
new: if (true) console.warn(`[busy] slow: the shed opened
note: AUDIT LEAN-READS C6: every slow request while it is open says it again

name: SLOWSHED-wait-unheard
old: noteD1Wait(tally.ms, tally.trips, Date.now());   // SLOW-SHED: the isolate's shed hears how long the database made it wait, a trip at a time
note: the service never hears its own wait

name: SLOWSHED-by-statements
note: AUDIT LEAN-READS C1: a batch's wait read over its statements, twelve times short

name: SLOWSHED-batch-untripped
old: } finally { add(tally, 'ms', Date.now() - started); add(tally, 'trips', 1); }   // SLOW-SHED (AUDIT LEAN-READS C1): and a batch one, whatever it carries
new: } finally { add(tally, 'ms', Date.now() - started); }   // SLOW-SHED (AUDIT LEAN-READS C1): and a batch one, whatever it carries
note: a batch's wait heard with no trip - the shed never weighs it

name: SLOWSHED-statement-untripped
old: } finally { add(tally, 'ms', Date.now() - started); add(tally, 'trips', 1); }   // SLOW-SHED (AUDIT LEAN-READS C1): a statement awaited is a trip
new: } finally { add(tally, 'ms', Date.now() - started); }   // SLOW-SHED (AUDIT LEAN-READS C1): a statement awaited is a trip
note: a lone statement's wait heard with no trip - a request of single statements never weighed

name: SLOWSHED-client-timeout-unheard
note: a display read that timed out asked again at once

name: SLOWSHED-client-any-read
note: an act that timed out holds the reads

name: SLOWSHED-client-unreachable
note: the player's own dropped line holds the reads

name: SLOWSHED-client-stall-each
note: AUDIT LEAN-READS C3: one stall's seven timeouts double the hold six times

name: SLOWSHED-client-no-doubling
note: timeouts in a row never wait longer
